exposure: Timing of cefuroxime surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis (SAP) administration before incision (0-30 minutes, 31-60 minutes, 61-120 minutes before incision; also 10-25 minutes vs 30-55 minutes)
cohort: Adult patients who underwent one of 11 major surgical procedures with cefuroxime surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis documented by the Swissnoso SSI surveillance system in Switzerland.
finding: Administration of cefuroxime surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis closer to the incision time was associated with significantly lower odds of surgical site infections.
